content:
The latest WhatsApp beta for iOS includes references to a revamped set of chat customization options, including animated wallpapers. Here are the details.

Animations will reportedly be subtle

As spotted by WABetaInfo, the latest WhatsApp build available on TestFlight includes references to something they had already found on a recent WhatsApp beta for Android: new sets of chat themes divided into categories called Featured, Doodle, and Minimal.

According to the report, Doodle will offer wallpapers inspired by WhatsApp’s classic doodle pattern, while Minimal will use solid white or black backgrounds depending on whether light or dark mode is enabled. Featured, meanwhile, will include wallpapers with subtle motion.

Here’s WABetaInfo:

The site also notes that chat bubble colors will vary depending on the wallpaper, with WhatsApp selecting them automatically rather than letting users customize them separately.

WABetaInfo says the feature is still under development and not yet available to beta testers. However, with WhatsApp now working on it for both iOS and Android, it may not be long before some beta testers begin seeing it ahead of a wider release.
